baslik: A Gas Explosion Brought Down a Whole Corner of a Tower

sahneler.metin: One kitchen gas explosion brought down a tower block's corner.
The floors collapsed one after another, and four people died.
Ronan Point had just opened in east London.
It was built from large prefabricated concrete panels.
The blast pushed out one load-bearing wall.
With nothing holding them, the floors above fell.
Their weight crushed the floors below.
Building rules were rewritten to stop disproportionate collapse.

aciklama:
Ronan Point lost an entire corner after a gas explosion. The cause: progressive collapse: prefabricated panels held by gravity and small joints, so one lost panel brought down those above and below.
